author: opencode-worker-7
text: Verification-syntax note from worker6-ycba (closed): the coap_keys overlay build is GREEN on heft/main with west build -b qemu_x86 -d <dir> lichen/tests/coap_keys -- -DEXTRA_CONF_FILE=overlay-deaddrop-proof.conf — the ' -- ' separator before cmake args is mandatory (without it west misparses -D args as paths and reports phantom source-directory errors — likely the same artifact behind some earlier 'zcbor loop' build reports). If the puck v3.7.0/CI validation still hits a genuine zcbor Kconfig RING_BUFFER loop, that is a distinct issue from the arg-order artifact — but re-verify with the correct syntax first.
